_description: Curated registry of known existing Pandoc Lua filters. When adding a custom filter, search Tavily first. If a pre-existing solution exists here, use it instead of writing bespoke code.

filters.name: revealjs-codeblock
filters.description: Code block framing for reveal.js slides

filters.name: include-files
filters.description: Include external Markdown files via fenced divs

filters.name: diagram
filters.description: Generate diagrams from Mermaid/Dot/PlantUML code blocks

filters.name: pandoc-quotes.lua
filters.description: Change default quotation marks per language

filters.name: citation-style-language (via --citeproc)
filters.description: Built-in citation processing (not a separate Lua filter)

custom_filters.description: These are our project's custom Lua filters. Each must justify why no existing solution was suitable.

entries.name: youtube-embed.lua
entries.purpose: Convert ::: {.youtube} fenced div to responsive YouTube iframe
entries.why_no_existing: No existing Pandoc Lua filter for in-slide YouTube embeds with responsive 16:9 container. The built-in reveal.js writer does not support YouTube embeds.
entries.search_query: pandoc lua filter reveal.js youtube embed responsive iframe

entries.name: audio-autoplay.lua
entries.purpose: Inject <audio data-autoplay> from heading attribute for reveal.js autoplay
entries.why_no_existing: No existing Lua filter for reveal.js audio autoplay from heading attrs. Pandoc's reveal.js writer does not support audio autoplay natively.
entries.search_query: pandoc lua filter reveal.js audio autoplay heading attribute

entries.name: slide-helper.lua
entries.purpose: Shared library module providing HTML generation functions used by other filters
entries.why_no_existing: This is a library (not a standalone filter) that consolidates HTML generation for all other custom filters. No equivalent in pandoc-ext.
entries.search_query: pandoc lua module shared library helper functions reveal.js
